name: NOAA ISD Global Hourly / Velana Intl
resolution: Hourly/synoptic meteorological reports; precipitation groups in the tested years are 6-, 12- and 24-hour totals, not hourly rainfall.
coverage: 2024 calendar year and 2025 Jan 1-Aug 24 downloaded. Station-history metadata spans 1981 Jan 1-2025 Aug 24 with possible gaps.
limitation: Measured nearby-station context at 6-hour/daily scale. Obtain MMS data for hourly/subhourly rainfall bursts. 2024: 10,784 meteorological rows; 1,666 nonempty AA groups, including 30 missing depths. 2025: 7,198 rows; 1,128 AA groups, including 21 missing depths. No 1-hour AA precipitation group found in either year. Quality and condition flags retained.
licence: Free download without login; cite NOAA and station source.

name: NOAA GSOD / Velana Intl
coverage: 2024: 355 dates, 354 nonmissing PRCP. 2025: 236 dates through Aug 24, all 236 with PRCP. Hulhule airport is not Male island proper.
limitation: Screen event dates and broad daily context; unsuitable for peak short-duration intensity or within-city rainfall variation. PRCP units are inches; raw attributes retained. 2024 is not complete. Missing dates and sentinel values are not zero.

name: NASA GPM IMERG Final V07
status: Free registration / Earthdata or PPS download route; files not downloaded
coverage: Official directory: Jan 1998-present, with about 3.5 months latency for Final. Global ocean/land coverage includes Male latitude; actual Male values have not been extracted here.
limitation: Best gridded subdaily fallback for regional event timing. Validate against gauges; not street-scale precipitation. Convert rate (mm/hour) to half-hour depth by multiplying by 0.5. Official directory and product documentation checked.
licence: Free NASA data; Earthdata or PPS registration for common download routes.

name: ERA5 hourly time-series single levels
coverage: 1940-present global atmosphere. A nearby grid point is returned for an off-grid request. Male island is not resolved.
limitation: Secondary reanalysis baseline; a large marine grid cell does not measure local convective rainfall peaks. Official dataset and download form checked; data not downloaded.
licence: CC-BY; free CDS registration and licence acceptance required.

name: ERA5-Land hourly
resolution: Hourly; 0.1 degree delivery grid, about 9 km native.
coverage: 1950-present land component. Valid Male grid-cell coverage has not been verified.
limitation: Do not treat global extent as proof of valid values on a tiny island. ERA5 atmosphere avoids this land-mask issue but remains coarse. Official catalogue checked; no actual Male valid-pixel test.

name: CHIRPS v3 daily final
resolution: Daily values derived from pentads; 0.05 degree grid (about 5.6 km), not subdaily.
coverage: Land, 60 N-60 S. At 4.175 N, 73.510 E the 2025 Jan 3 final-sat COG contains a valid estimate of 108.274635314941 mm. One pixel/date is verified, not the complete historical record.
limitation: Useful for daily/climate context, not short-duration waterlogging intensity. Daily v3 inherits pentad totals and ERA5/IMERG timing; do not use agreement with those inputs as independent validation. Official v3 description and daily README checked. Actual COG sampled using GDAL; a 3-by-3-cell context GeoTIFF is saved. CHIRPS v2 ends after Dec 2026.

name: JASL/UHSLC Male record1082, versionB
limitation: Water levels are mm relative station zero, not flood depth or automatically MSL. Reconcile vertical datums before combining with elevation. Includes a units row after header.
licence: Free use/redistribution per ERDDAP metadata; cite DOI10.7289/V5V40S7W.
